podcast.title: Softer Alt Rock Trend (2010s)
podcast.body: This band is listed as one of the acts that fit into the trend of softer sounding and poppier alt rock that emerged in the 2010s, a style influenced by Mumford & Sons. "Of monsters and men, kaleo, George Ezra, Vance Joy, Hosea, Congo's, walk off the earth and walk the moon."
